About Ram Sweets & Snacks

Authentic Madurai sweets & savouries, since 1998.

Our Story

What began in 1998 as a small family kitchen in the heart of Madurai has grown into a name loved across Tamil Nadu for its authentic sweets and snacks. Ram Sweets & Snacks was founded on one simple belief: food made with care and the finest ingredients always tastes better. Every recipe we serve today carries forward the traditions passed down through generations of our family — from the way our Ghee Mysore Pak is hand-cut to the exact roast of our Kovilpatti groundnuts.

Over the years, we have stayed true to our roots while growing to serve customers across the country. Our kitchens still follow the same time-tested methods, using pure ghee, fresh milk, and hand-picked ingredients sourced locally from Madurai and the surrounding region.

What We Stand For

Freshly Prepared

Every batch is made fresh daily in small quantities to ensure the best taste and quality.

Lab-Tested Ingredients

We source and test every ingredient to meet strict quality and hygiene standards.

Traditional Recipes

Recipes passed down through generations, unchanged in spirit for over 25 years.

Pan-India Delivery

From our Madurai kitchens to your doorstep, anywhere in India.

Our Promise

Whether it is a festival, a wedding, or simply a craving for something sweet, Ram Sweets & Snacks promises the same quality and authenticity in every box — just like it was in 1998.
